description: Least-squares forward and feedback equalizer taps on the training (conventions: Synchronization, Least-squares equalizer taps).

cases.source: by hand: x_n = g a_n with one tap, so the error is 0 at w = 1/g
by hand: x_n = a_n + h a_{n-1} with one forward and one feedback tap on a_{n-1}, so the error is 0 at w = 1, b = -h
by hand: a channel 1 + h1 z^-1 + h2 z^-2 + h3 z^-3 with one forward tap and three feedback taps on the past training: the error is 0 at w = 1, b = -h
